card.name: Or/and after underdosing-type terms
card.fires_on: The linking word "or" or "and" right after "underdosing" or a similar dosing-problem term, where the next word is a contrasting term such as overdosing or exceeding. It also fires weakly on other joining words in dosing sentences.

modes.label: or after underdosing
modes.description: The word "or" follows underdosing and leads into overdosing or excess exposure.
modes.example: avoid underdosing<< or>> exceeding the recommended adult dose.

modes.label: Other linking words in dosing text
modes.description: Linking words or punctuation such as "and", "to" or "(" appear in dosing or administration lines.
modes.example: during and immediately after intravenous<< and>> intramuscular injection of phytonad

card.plain: It marks the small word "or" after underdosing, just before the opposite problem of too much drug is named.
